messages:
ci-bot: ALERT: nightly-smallbatch (run 375123) p95 latency +42% vs baseline. Job link: https://ci.redwood/bench/375123 :warning:

oliver: Oof. I saw a similar bump earlier but it was transient. Can someone attach the flamegraph from that run?

sasha: Pulling logs now. Starting an isolated reproduce on bench-4 (g4dn.xlarge) with the same model shard and seq=512.

maya: @sasha thanks. tagging extra traces: please add `--trace=alloc,kv` when you run.

ben: If we can get a perf profile, I can correlate with the recent allocator patch (PR #4127). Might be an alloc hotspot.

oncall-kate: I enabled verbose tracing for nightly-smallbatch for the next two runs. Will keep retention 72h.

ci-bot: run artifacts: https://ci.redwood/bench/375123/artifacts (flamegraph: flame_375123.svg, logs: smallbatch.log.gz)

oliver: Quick paste from the top of smallbatch.log.gz:
```
[2026-03-16T02:14:02Z] request id=abc123 p95=142ms p50=18ms qsize=3
[2026-03-16T02:14:02Z] model shard load time=11ms kv-cache hit=0.82
[2026-03-16T02:14:12Z] sampling loop: alloc spike +30MB in 120ms
[2026-03-16T02:14:12Z] scheduler: worker-3 stalled for 210ms (gc?)
```

maya: That "alloc spike" + scheduler stall looks suspicious. Could be a new path creating temporary tensors during attention kernel.

ben: I can run a build with the allocator debug flags: `make bench-alloc && ./bench --alloc-check` on bench-4. Want me to proceed?

oliver: Yes please. Also capture `/proc/slabinfo` during the run and `nvidia-smi pmon -d 1` to rule out GPU throttling.

oncall-kate: I'm on bench-4 now, running with `--trace=alloc,kv --alloc-check`. Started at 02:42Z. Will post artifacts.

sasha: While that's running, I kicked off a bisect window across commits `main~10..main`. If we see the regression reproduce, we can narrow the change quickly. Bisect job id: 375124-bisect-7.

ben: Nice. If bisect narrows to PR #4127 or #4132 I have a quick revert ready.

ci-bot: bisect update: 3/10 runs failed to reproduce, 1/10 hit similar p95 pattern (run 375124-4).

oliver: OK, partial repro. Can @ben and @maya attach the exact config used in the failing run (batch size, seq len, quantization flags)? I want deterministic repro.

maya: failing run config: `--batch=6 --seq=512 --quant=8bit --kv-cache=on` (matches nightly).

ben: I'm reproducing locally with same config now. If I can get a flamegraph I'll throw it up. ETA ~18m.

oliver: Plan for next 24h: 1) preserve failing artifacts (oncall-kate), 2) finish bisect until we have a single culprit commit (sasha+ben), 3) attempt patch/revert (ben) or allocator tweak (maya), 4) keep nightly with verbose traces until resolved (ci-bot/oncall-kate).

oncall-kate: Artifacts preserved at https://ci.redwood/bench/375123/preserved. I also bumped retention for all subsequent smallbatch runs to 7d.

sasha: FYI I'll post interim updates to this thread as bisect progresses. If someone wants direct handoff, ping me or add notes in the bisect job.

ben: Flamegraph: https://ci.redwood/bench/375124-4/flame_375124-4.svg — there's a big wedge under `attention::kv_store::ensure_cached`

maya: That matches the allocator spike. I'm starting a run with a micro-fix: avoid temporary buffer allocation in kv_store when `seq<=512`. Patching now.

oliver: Great. If the patch removes the wedge and p95 drops to baseline, we'll ship as hotfix to dedicated and nightly. Otherwise escalate to infra.

ci-bot: NOTE: scheduled rollback window at 2026-03-17T04:00:00Z if regression persists.

oncall-kate: Logging this as an ops incident with low severity: INC-2026-0316-04. I'll prepare the postmortem template if we need it.

sasha: Update: bisect narrowed to commit `a9f3d2` (PR #4132). Ben, can you test reverting that specifically?

ben: Revert tested locally — p95 returns to baseline in my run. I'll open an emergency revert PR and tag @oliver for review.

oliver: Reviewing now. If CI passes, let's merge revert and run a clean nightly. Good job team. :tada:
